tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. Warm ivory, never pure white.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Cards and raised surfaces on paper.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body text on paper or paper-raised (16:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, metadata on paper (6.6:1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline rules, card borders, dividers. Decorative only.

tokens.name: silver
tokens.usage: Oxidized silver. Icons, illustration strokes, disabled states. Not for text on paper (2.9:1).

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: Second accent: rules, monogram, contour lines, small decorative marks. Not for text on paper (2.8:1).

tokens.name: brass-ink
tokens.usage: Brass when it must be read: eyebrows and small labels on paper (4.8:1).

tokens.name: turquoise
tokens.usage: Signature accent fill: large shapes, highlights, the cover. Not for text on paper (3.1:1).

tokens.name: turquoise-ink
tokens.usage: Turquoise for text and controls: links, primary buttons, the italic accent word, focus rings (5.1:1 on paper; white text on it 5.7:1).

tokens.name: turquoise-tint
tokens.usage: Tag and pill backgrounds, hover wash. Pair with turquoise-ink text.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Case study and essay card titles.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gaps inside tags, icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile, gaps between related items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, grid gutters.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pill tags and filter chips only.
